g.text: abandons it: the old configuration is
held until the rotation is done: it can only go forward
ichor cluster rotate-ca writes the new credentials next to yours as
.ichor-new files and checks them. In the UI an admin downloads
them. Then the operation goes on.
Each stage is applied to every node and checked before the next
begins. A step that cannot be checked pauses the operation.
